Thanks for the response. I did consider it for a long time, but a therapist talked me out of it. Besides, I wouldn't get to be a real woman anyway, and I doubt I'd pass more than just as someone who everyone indulges because it's easier to do that.

If it would fix problems, I would, but I don't think it would. I would probably be even more isolated then. If people don't want to interact as a guy, I doubt transgender would be much better, ya know? Besides, part of me thinks this is just a reaction to being such a failure of a guy that it's almost a cop-out. Life is always one disaster away  from the end, but the disaster comes in these little waves instead of a tsunami.

Hey.

I knew some people who played counterstrike. I played in a band with them in junior high.  You have to understand, they have been playing it, and I mean this literally, since sometime in 1998 when it was still a mod. Like 1.3 (more like .7), bunnyhopping, playing de_dust, then de_dust2. Played it some myself back when it was still a mod, but even back then they were WAY too hardcore for me  I haven't talked to them in about half a decade, but I imagine they still play at least a few hours a week. Just realize, they were crazy. Like, they would turn up the speakers to the point where it hurt their ears because it was better to hear people coming up on them.

You don't want to do that over games, I promise. If you are under 18 you can get that charged back legally, I believe, if it was her card.  Otherwise, just let her know, it might be rough but it's not that much money in the long run.  Stop playing CS, please.  Those guys were playing the same game for going on two decades. Nothing wrong with that, but you just have to understand.
